what: No loader, once fonts arrive the hero title floats half-faded (.45), sharpens within one beat, and the description and buttons follow at eighth-note (.211s) intervals

options.bpm: Beat tempo — all lengths in beat units, default 142 (one beat .4225s)
options.soft: If set, starts at .45 instead of 0 (title)
options.order: Order within the same page (smaller comes first), default document order
